about: [O1b critic] the new street things against a man and a car at the Grand Ave start: what lies near (C.dress by kind), then on foot into the nearest few (walked into, punched), then the coupe taken by E and driven up the kerb along the pavement; every smash event counted.

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.stage.part('city').C; const p = N.controller.pos; const by = {}; for (const d of C.dress) by[d.kind] = (by[d.kind]||0)+1; const near = C.dress.map(d => ({k: d.kind, sm: d.smash||null, x:+d.x.toFixed(1), z:+d.z.toFixed(1), d:+Math.hypot(d.x-p.x,d.z-p.z).toFixed(0)})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d).slice(0,14); return JSON.stringify({n: C.dress.length, by, inv: G.save.inventory, near}); })()

(() => { const p = G.camera.position; const dx = -92.9-p.x, dy = 0.6-p.y, dz = 17.5-p.z; N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); N.controller.pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); return 1; })()

JSON.stringify({sm: window.__sm, pos:[+N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1),+N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)], inCar: G.city.inCar, kmh: G.city.car ? +(G.city.car.speed*3.6).toFixed(0) : null, txt: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,120)})
